description.narrative: The International Development Association (IDA) is an international financial institution which offers concessional loans and grants to the world's poorest developing countries. IDA is a member of the World Bank Group (WBG) and complements the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development(IBRD) by lending to developing countries which suffer from the lowest gross national income, from troubled creditworthiness, or from the lowest per capita income. Funding under this initiative represents a core grant payment Australia's contribution to IDA19. The total value of this initiative is $104.192 million covering the period 2020-21-2028-29.
